result.summary: Found 1 significant accessibility/visual issue in the promotional banner; excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff as requested.

issues.description: The mint promotional banner uses white text (“3 free deliveries for you” and the code details) on a very light green background, making the copy low-contrast and hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or switch the headline/subtext to a dark green/neutral color so the text meets WCAG contrast guidance.
